preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)
The contract must have some bonus pool balance (dayPoolBouns[yesToday] > 0)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call sumBounsPiece() with a very large number (e.g., type(uint256).max / eachPiece) for the current day's date string (yesToday). This will set dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday] to an extremely high value. Then, when any user calls receiveBounsToken(), the _sumCanGetToken() function will attempt to subtract dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday].mul(balancePiece) from dayPoolBouns[yesToday], causing an arithmetic underflow and reverting the transaction. This effectively locks all bonus distributions.
